Yoroi recognises the importance of responsible governance during periods of ecosystem uncertainty. Ecosystem Situation: The trust our delegators place in Yoroi requires that we act only when we can do so with full confidence. I vote No as an SPO on raising k to 1000. I share the goal of more independent operators, but raising k doesn’t reach them. It cuts rewards for delegators in ~200 established pools and operators can just open more pools, as happened last time. Better-targeted measures exist. A PDF version of this rationale is also made available. 6eddf4f1dbad06f329aa69743559c4930b7b689f.excerpt: I vote NO on “Cardano Strategic Copper Reserve”. As I understand it, this proposal asks for ₳22M to get three things. I looked at each one in numbers to see whether the cost is justified. Treasury diversification (buying copper): I don’t think the cost is justified, and there is a risk of losing principal. Of the ₳22M, ₳14.7M (about 67%) goes into buying copper. The remaining ~₳7.3M (about 33%) is spent as fees regardless of the copper price. By the proposal’s own numbers, copper must rise about 49% (about $10.06/lb) just to return the principal, and the sale is planned for 2028–2029. The ₳22M also goes first into an account controlled by the recipient (Toto Finance). Independent oversight…

6eddf4f1dbad06f329aa69743559c4930b7b689f.excerpt: I vote No on this proposal. I recognize the value of demonstrating real-world asset tokenization on Cardano. This is a vote against the structure of this request, not against Toto Finance, real-world asset tokenization, or the copper thesis. 6eddf4f1dbad06f329aa69743559c4930b7b689f.name: Leandros BSP
6eddf4f1dbad06f329aa69743559c4930b7b689f.excerpt: No: off-chain content is not immutable This vote is No because governance action gov_action1dmwlfuwm45r0x2d2d96r2kwyjv9hk6ylzmq8xpsay2xecesn6xwqqdlv55z (6eddf4f1dbad06f329aa69743559c4930b7b689f16c073061d228d9c6613d19c#0) violates Article II, Section 6.1 of the Cardano Blockchain Ecosystem Constitution. That section requires the off-chain document for a governance action to be immutable and incapable of being altered after submission. totalDrepPowerAda.definition: Summed voting power (lovelace) over every non-special DRep snapshot row for the epoch.

poweredDrepCount.definition: Non-special DRep snapshot rows with voting power above zero this epoch.

recentlyVotingDrepCount.definition: DReps that voted at least once in the last 12 epochs, superseded votes included. Votes without a block time are not counted.

silentPoweredDrepCount.definition: DReps holding delegated power in the epoch snapshot with no vote in the last 12 epochs, superseded votes included. NULL until the repair pass has read the epoch.

abstainPowerAda.definition: Voting power (lovelace) delegated to the predefined always-abstain option this epoch.

ancPowerAda.definition: Voting power (lovelace) delegated to the predefined no-confidence option this epoch.

delegatorTotal.definition: Sum of live-observed delegator counts over the epoch snapshot rows, set only when every row carries an observation, never a partial sum.

abstainDelegators.definition: Live-observed delegator count of the always-abstain option, recorded from the epoch stamping began.

ancDelegators.definition: Live-observed delegator count of the no-confidence option, recorded from the epoch stamping began.

gini.definition: Gini coefficient of voting power across snapshot rows with power above zero, excluding the predefined options.

top10SharePct.definition: Share of the epoch total held by the ten largest non-special DReps, computed from the raw power distribution.

minCoalition50.definition: Fewest DReps whose combined voting power reaches 50% of the epoch total, based on delegated power, not actual coordination.

minCoalition67.definition: Fewest DReps whose combined voting power reaches 67% of the epoch total, based on delegated power, not actual coordination.

votesCast.definition: DRep votes cast during the epoch, later-superseded votes included. Votes without a block time are not counted.
